interpretation.stock_status: The photographed Levita color-card page itself is labeled Stock Service. This confirms these displayed swatches are presented as stock-service colors in this sample book; it does not establish that the 36 visible colors are the entire Levita stock palette.
interpretation.visual_structure_note: The yarn wraps show a fine continuous sheen and a clearly twisted appearance that are visually consistent with the supplier explanation of a combined-twist construction and a filament Viscose side. The photo alone does not identify the Polyester-side yarn form, component counts, twist direction, twist level, denier/dtex, or filament count.
